items.title: Review Article Catalytic asymmetric synthesis of 1,2-diamines Francisco Foubelo, Carmen Nájera, M a Gracia Retamosa, José M. Sansano and Miguel Yus The asymmetric catalytic synthesis of 1,2-diamines has received considerable interest, due to their presence in biologically active compounds and their applications for the development of synthetic building blocks, chiral ligands and organocatalysts.

Paper Corroboration of Zn( II )–Mg( II )-tertiary structure interplays essential for the optimal catalysis of a phosphorothiolate thiolesterase ribozyme Tzu-Pin Wang, Yu-Chih Su, Yi Chen, Scott Severance, Chi-Ching Hwang, Yi-Ming Liou, Chia-Hui Lu, Kun-Liang Lin, Rui Jing Zhu and Eng-Chi Wang Zn( II ) and Mg( II ) and GAGA tetraloop in the ion atmosphere of the TW17 ribozyme is critical to optimal ribozyme catalysis at alkaline pH.

Review Article A comprehensive overview of directing groups applied in metal-catalysed C–H functionalisation chemistry Carlo Sambiagio, David Schönbauer, Remi Blieck, Toan Dao-Huy, Gerit Pototschnig, Patricia Schaaf, Thomas Wiesinger, Muhammad Farooq Zia, Joanna Wencel-Delord, Tatiana Besset, Bert U. W. Maes and Michael Schnürch The present review is devoted to summarizing the recent advances (2015–2017) in the field of metal-catalysed group-directed C–H functionalisation.

Perspective Picking the lock of coordination cage catalysis Tomasz K. Piskorz, Vicente Martí-Centelles, Rebecca L. Spicer, Fernanda Duarte and Paul J. Lusby We provide an overview of coordination cage catalysis, highlighting how mechanistic understanding can help address the challenges in this area leading to new opportunities in non-covalent reactivity.

Review Article Thermo-photo catalysis: a whole greater than the sum of its parts Siyuan Fang and Yun Hang Hu This review provides an up-to-date understanding on emerging thermo-photo catalytic processes with an emphasis on the synergetic effects of thermal and photo energies.

Review Article Metal-catalyzed regiodivergent organic reactions Carmen Nájera, Irina P. Beletskaya and Miguel Yus This review discusses metal-catalysed regiodivergent additions, allylic substitutions, CH-activation, cross-couplings and intra- or intermolecular cyclisations.

Review Article Activation and catalytic transformation of methane under mild conditions Yu Tang, Yuting Li and Franklin (Feng) Tao In the last few decades, scientists have been motivated by promising production of chemicals from methane under mild conditions for low energy consumption and climate remediation; significant fundamental understanding on this topic has been achieved.

Review Article Photo and earth-abundant metal dual catalysis in organic synthesis Guannan Li, Tongtong Li, Lifeng Luo, Yan Tan and Zhan Lu This review summarizes the latest research progress on photocatalytic reactions involving typical Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, and Cu metal catalysts, mainly focusing on the role of metals and light in the reaction process.

Review Article Advances in N-heterocyclic carbene organocatalysis from 2015 to 2024 Dan Ling, Yusong Ran, Fachang Yang, Xiaoqun Yang, Xingxing Wu, Shi-Chao Ren and Zhichao Jin The key progress in the field of N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) organocatalysis during the period of 2015 to 2024 is systematically summarized and discussed in this review.

Perspective Plasma catalysis: what is needed to create synergy? Joran Van Turnhout, Kevin Rouwenhorst, Leon Lefferts and Annemie Bogaerts In this paper, we describe the critical limitations towards plasma–catalyst synergy and suggest possible solutions.

items.title: Review Article Applications of metal–organic frameworks in heterogeneous supramolecular catalysis Jiewei Liu, Lianfen Chen, Hao Cui, Jianyong Zhang, Li Zhang and Cheng-Yong Su The contributions of MOFs to the field of heterogeneous supramolecular catalysis are comprehensively reviewed with regard to active sites, selectivity, as well as host–guest chemistry.

Tutorial Review Intelligent catalysis: on-demand dynamic self-optimization via responsive feedback Linbo Jiang and Shichun Mu This review investigates intelligent self-optimization effects, responsive mechanisms and multimodal intelligent catalysis, associated challenges and solutions, aiming to promote on-demand applications in complex multi-scenario environments.

Review Article Asymmetric heterogeneous catalysis using crystalline porous materials Teng Li, Yan-Ting Chen, Xiao-Bin Zhang, Rong-Rong Du, Lin-Na Ma and Ya-Qian Lan This review discusses the design and synthesis methods and asymmetric catalytic applications of chiral crystalline porous materials, focusing on asymmetric heterogeneous reactions and chiral control mechanisms.

Perspective Synergistic catalysis: A powerful synthetic strategy for new reaction development Anna E. Allen and David W. C. MacMillan Synergistic catalysis, the simultaneous activation of two reacting partners by discrete catalysts to enable new or elusive chemical transformations, is a valuable synthetic strategy that is growing in popularity. This review seeks to describe the new transformations that highlight the rapid onset of this powerful multi-catalysis concept.
